/zenelectrical/case-study/electrical-and.intro: How Electrical & Data Service Company (EDS) kept its customer-first promise while growing, by moving scheduling, bids and job notes onto ZenElectrical.

kpis.l: For the whole team to get on board
Job details and notes from the field

chapters.label: The challenge
chapters.title: Growth was about to hit a wall
chapters.body: With more projects and clients coming in, it got harder to handle several jobs at once without a streamlined workflow. Scheduling, bids and client communication were juggled all at once, and staying organized became a nightmare.

list.t: Dispatching electricians and tracking visits got harder over time.
Managing bids and clients with incomplete forms and job details.
They needed one digital workflow to save time.

chapters.quote: Honestly, we couldn’t figure out how we managed without it for such a long time.

chapters.label: The solution
chapters.title: Straightforward, efficient and flexible
chapters.body: EDS explored different tools carefully before choosing. ZenElectrical stood out as a complete solution that could handle their main gap, scheduling, and within a few days the whole team was on board.

chapters.label: Getting onboarded
chapters.title: Like learning to ride a bike
chapters.body: The ZenElectrical team guided EDS through onboarding, set the business up and migrated its data. Scheduling was the biggest win: technicians know where to be and what to do, and can see each customer’s past service history from the field.
chapters.quote: Being able to add job details and notes on the fly? That was a real game changer.

chapters.label: Where they are now
chapters.title: Moving forward, spirit intact
chapters.body: EDS has streamlined its workflow, cut the time spent on redundant tasks, and brought its focus back to delivering great electrical service, while keeping the customer-first spirit that built the business.

/zenelectrical/case-study/electrical-and.about: Master electrician Troy Exler and journeyman wireman Bryan Cady founded Electrical & Data Service Company in 2014 with one mission: always put customers first. In 2020 Bryan passed the torch to his son Kevin, and Sheryl joined as a co-owner.
